parts.text: Write the complete first-pass specification for a procedure that communicates a prompt to Gemini. Use the configured MetaProcedure, JavaScript archive, and Agents.md JSON projection as the supplied evidence. Produce the full specification now, not an analysis or discovery pass. Use only the minimum additional rules necessary. The final result must conform to JWRS and must include complete values under gemini-prompt-communicator.js, gemini-prompt-workflow.yaml, and gemini-prompt-message-config.json. The configuration template must use minimally verbose keys while covering every configuration category evidenced by the archived JavaScript.
